q: we present a systematic empirical study of harness effects in SE agents
r: Include: controlled comparison of harnesses and ten models across three benchmarks is the evaluation contribution.

q: We introduce WIDESWE to evaluate coding agents on such cross-repository tasks.
r: Include: new benchmark of 60 bug-fix and 60 feature cross-repository tasks across seven agent configurations.

q: an end-to-end workflow for analyzing what developers write to an agent, what they do while it works
r: Include: human-effort evaluation method for developers working with a coding agent (Copilot); method is the contribution.

q: a benchmark and evaluation framework for agentic game development inside Roblox Studio
r: Include: new benchmark with 16 attempts per task and exploration metrics; agents write game scripts.

q: coordination among parallel coding agents is a scheduling problem
r: Include: NP-Bench is a new three-arm benchmark for evaluating coordination of parallel coding agents.

q: We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering
r: Include: new benchmark where coding agents build agents from natural-language requirements (project level).

q: a paired evaluation design that runs each later maintenance task twice
r: Include: new paired evaluation design and benchmark for agent maintenance; contribution is the evaluation method.

q: We analyze 600 publicly released coding-agent trajectories spanning two agent scaffolds and two language models.
r: Include: cost-metric analysis of coding-agent loops with cache-aware cost model; evaluation-method contribution.

q: We introduce ANCHOR (Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding), a benchmark
r: Include: new benchmark of repository tasks assessing constraint following across 19 agent configurations.

q: We introduce SWE-Residual, a benchmark for Starting-State Robustness
r: Include: new benchmark evaluating coding agents continuing earlier work; evaluation-method contribution.
